attacks.name: Plasma Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: The World is Mine
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character removes 1 |!damage| from itself for each |!damage| dealt.

superPowers.name: Hydra High Council (Affiliation: Hydra)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, after an attack made by an allied character is resolved, if the attack dealt |!damage|, the allied character may use this leadership ability. Choose one special condition the allied character has. If the defending enemy character does not have the chosen special condition, it gains it and then the allied attacking character loses that special condition.|\|Additionally, once per Turn, when an enemy character gains a special condition, the allied character that caused the effect may remove 1 |!damage| from itself.

superPowers.name: Deathspore Virus
superPowers.body: Other characters within |!range| 3 of this character gain the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

superPowers.name: Arrogance
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking, before rolling attack dice, this character may use this superpower. During this attack, add |!failure| in the attack roll to the total number of successes for the attack roll. During this attack, add |!failure| in the defense roll to the total number of successes for the defense roll.

superPowers.name: Tactical Insight
superPowers.body: While this character or another allied character within |!range| 2 is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. That allied character may reroll 1 die in their roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
